title: Computer Patient Simulations
description: Information gathering and decision making in the management of patients with acute and chronic respiratory conditions. Intended for students in the Respiratory Therapy program; enrollment is limited to students accepted in the program.
outcomes: Employs learned knowledge to successfully pass all clinical simulation programs
Selects appropriate tests and treatments to successfully pass all clinical simulations programs.
objectives: Obtain patient data, evaluate patient data and make recommendations
Manipulate equipment by order or protocol including infection and quality control
Show competence in managing various respiratory disorders by successfully completing information gathering and decision making segments of clinical simulations
content: Review patient data and make recommendations
Maternal and perinatal/neonatal history and data
Recommend procedures to obtain additional data
Equipment manipulation, infection and quality control
Initiation and modification of therapeutic procedures
Maintain a patent airway including care of artificial airways
Evaluate patient's response to respiratory care
Independently modify procedures based on patient response
Recommend modifications to the patient's care plan
Initiate, conduct or modify respiratory care techniques in an emergency setting
Act as an assistant to the physician performing special procedures
Initiate and conduct pulmonary rehabilitation and home care
lab: The student will review patient data and make recommendations based on information such as:
Maternal and perinatal/neonatal history and data
Based on data gathered the student will recommend the following:
Recommend other procedures to obtain additional data
The student shall be able to demonstrate equipment manipulation, infection and quality control such as:
Initiation and modification of therapeutic procedures
Maintain a patent airway including care of artificial airways
Evaluate patient's response to respiratory care
Independently modify procedures based on patient response
Recommend modifications to the patient's care plan
Initiate, conduct or modify respiratory care techniques in an emergency setting
Act as an assistant to the physician performing special procedures
Initiate and conduct pulmonary rehabilitation and home care
